SELECT instance AS metric,disk_bytes AS value FROM ga_metrics WHERE instance_id<>'admin' AND ts=(SELECT MAX(ts) FROM ga_metrics) AND ('${instanz:raw}'='__all__' OR instance_id='${instanz:raw}') ORDER BY instance

SELECT instance AS metric,db_bytes AS value FROM ga_metrics WHERE instance_id<>'admin' AND ts=(SELECT MAX(ts) FROM ga_metrics) AND ('${instanz:raw}'='__all__' OR instance_id='${instanz:raw}') ORDER BY instance
SELECT MAX(quota_used)*100.0/NULLIF(MAX(quota_limit),0) AS value FROM ga_metrics WHERE ts=(SELECT MAX(ts) FROM ga_metrics)
SELECT MAX(ram_used)*100.0/NULLIF(MAX(ram_limit),0) AS value FROM ga_metrics WHERE ts=(SELECT MAX(ts) FROM ga_metrics)

SELECT CONCAT('von ',COUNT(*)) AS metric,SUM(healthy) AS value FROM ga_metrics WHERE instance_id<>'admin' AND ts=(SELECT MAX(ts) FROM ga_metrics) AND ('${instanz:raw}'='__all__' OR instance_id='${instanz:raw}')

SELECT SUM(disk_bytes) AS value FROM ga_metrics WHERE instance_id<>'admin' AND ts=(SELECT MAX(ts) FROM ga_metrics) AND ('${instanz:raw}'='__all__' OR instance_id='${instanz:raw}')
